component.name: KQuickShare
component.summary: Send files and text between Android and KDE Plasma
Передача файлов и текста между Android и KDE Plasma

description.p: KQuickShare uses Android's built-in Quick Share over a local network. Receive files in the system tray, send from Dolphin, and copy received text to the clipboard. No companion Android app is required.

The application uses Qt 6 and KDE Frameworks 6. It supports explicit acceptance or automatic reception from trusted devices, progress, cancellation, and optional startup at login. It is an independent community project, unaffiliated with Google or KDE.
Clipboard reception, cross-distribution installation, native package recipes, and compatibility checks.
